Uses of Class
org.ddolib.layered.solver.Solution

Packages that use Solution
Package
Description
org.ddolib.examples.layered.pdptw
This package contains the implementation of the One vehicle Pickup and Delivery Problem with Time Window (PDPTW) it has two twists: - it only supports one vehicle because DDO-like solvers have this limitation - it can incorporate unrelated nodes that are not within a pickup/delivery pair of node.
org.ddolib.layered.modeling
This package contains the interfaces and abstract classes that must be implemented as problem specific classes to model a problem with the layered API (fixed, known number of variables).
org.ddolib.layered.solver
This package contains the Solver interface implemented by every layered solver, and the Solution wrapper used to report a solution as a sequence of Decision.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.acs.core.solver
This package implements the Acs (Anytime Column Search) solver for the layered API.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.astar.core.solver
This package implements the A* solver for the layered API.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.awastar.core.solver
This package implements the Anytime Weighted A* solver for the layered API.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.solver
This package contains solvers using the DDO (Branch-and-Bound with decision diagrams) algorithm for the layered API: SequentialSolver (full DDO with relaxed and restricted MDDs), ExactSolver (exact MDD only), and RelaxationSolver / RestrictionSolver (a single relaxed/restricted MDD, mainly used internally and for testing bounds).
org.ddolib.layered.solving.lns.core.solver
This package implements the LNS (Large Neighborhood Search) solver, layered API only.
